data.source_title: An Objective Method to Determine Nurse Staffing for an Acute Care for Elders (ACE) Hospital Unit: Discrete Event Simulation
data.locator: Methods, unit workflow; staff huddles and breaks; published 2025
data.source_setting: 22-bed acute care for elders unit, Vanderbilt University Medical Center, Nashville, Tennessee
data.source_period: Publication 2025-05-09; exact direct-observation dates not stated in inspected abstract/sections
data.source_n: 22-bed unit; mean census 19 patients/day; staff sample and break observations not stated in accessible inspected sections
data.quantity: Scheduled non-care time per modeled staff shift
data.unit: minutes per simulated 12-hour shift; model inputs
data.source_evidence_basis: The study's DES specification scheduled a 7am–7pm day shift, two 15-minute shift huddles, a 30-minute meal break and two 15-minute breaks per staff member. These are model schedule assumptions informed by local clinical input, not measured break-taking or universal entitlement/compliance data.
data.limitations: ACE inpatient unit, not ED; scenario schedule inputs do not establish breaks actually taken, coverage availability, local law, union agreement or RWJ roster. Authors' simulated staffing outputs are not observed staffing results.
data.inferred_scenario_use: If a scenario includes breaks, make them explicit scheduled availability intervals and model coverage/overlap as local assumptions; distinguish scheduled break from verified absence and do not silently treat the entire roster as continuously available.
